FeedPatch.description: PATCH: omitted field stays unchanged. Only auto_read and transport permit explicit null; other null values return 400 (not 422).
FeedPatch.title: FeedPatch

count.description: Exact integers above JavaScript safe range are sent as ASCII decimal strings. Count mode requires count >= 1 and null date; date mode requires null count and a nonfuture ISO date in the named IANA timezone. These cross-field constraints are enforced by the server.

Overrides.description: PATCH: omitted field stays unchanged; explicit null resets inheritance; a value sets this owner override. No automatic defaults are sent by clients.
Overrides.title: Overrides

YouTubeSettings.description: Existing JSON patch-like PUT: omitted credentials remain stored, clear_credentials removes them. Strings contain no control characters. Proxy mode requires HTTP(S) address with no credentials/path/query/fragment.

ReaderSession.description: Local reader token, explicitly supplied. Host must be loopback; Origin if supplied must match the HTTP origin. Never persist the token in docs.

info.description: Canonical API-first contract. Edit this file; builds never infer or overwrite it from FastAPI. Abort ends client waiting, not committed writes. A lost connection leaves the outcome unknown and does not justify retrying a command.
info.title: Око Reader API
